meta.title: Raphael · Personal memory assistant
meta.description: Your personal journal and memory assistant

home.title: Keep a little of everyday life.
home.description: Thoughts, moments, everyday life — start with a few words. Sign in to your own journal.

login.heading: Sign in to your journal
login.allowedOnly: Available to approved Google accounts only.
login.unavailable: Unable to check your session right now.
login.initFailed: Unable to initialize sign-in. Check the settings and reload.

chat.title: Capture a moment
chat.subtitle: A place for your thoughts.
chat.motto: Every little moment is worth remembering.
chat.private: Personal journal · Only you can see it
chat.welcomeDetail: A thought, a conversation, or how you feel today. No need to organize it — start with a sentence.
chat.empty: No entries yet. Start with one little thing from today.
chat.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
chat.loginNewTab: Sign in in a new tab
chat.checkSaved: Refresh to check whether it was saved. Load earlier entries if needed.
chat.allowRetry: I checked: it was not saved. Allow resend.
chat.accountChanged: The signed-in account changed. Reopen the chat.
chat.deleteUnknown: Unable to confirm deletion. Cancel and refresh to check. The original remains in the database.
chat.discardLogout: You have unsaved text. Discard it and sign out?
chat.logoutFailed: Sign-out failed. Please try again later.

composer.label: What you want to remember
composer.placeholder: What would you like to remember?
composer.tooLong: Over 10,000 characters. Shorten the text before sending.

actions.title: Delete this entry?
actions.description: It will be hidden from the chat. The original remains in the database. Restoring entries is not available yet.
actions.choose: Choose an action for this entry.

admin.title: Allowed accounts
admin.description: Add a Google email to grant access. Disabling blocks future access and keeps existing entries.
admin.listFailed: Unable to load the list. Check your session and refresh.
admin.legacy: Existing allowed account (add its email to complete the details)
admin.refreshFailed: The action completed, but the list could not be loaded. Please refresh.
admin.unknown: Unable to confirm the result. Refresh to check, or verify admin sign-in and Firebase settings before retrying.
admin.confirm: {action} access for {account}? Personal entries will be kept.

record.heading: What would you like to remember today?
record.help: A thought, someone you met, or a little thing worth keeping.

validation.tooLong: Each entry can contain up to 10,000 characters. Shorten it before saving.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in and try again. Unsent text stays on this page.
errors.forbidden: This action was not allowed. Check your account or refresh and try again.
errors.notFound: This entry no longer exists. Please refresh the list.
errors.invalid: Check that the text is not blank and is within 10,000 characters.
errors.generic: Unable to complete the action. Check your connection and try again.
errors.saveUnknown: Unable to confirm the save. Your text has been kept. Refresh the list before retrying to avoid duplicates.
errors.authService: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

auth.cookie: Sign-in was submitted, but no valid session was retained. Allow cookies and use the same site URL throughout sign-in.

googleErrors.popup-blocked: Allow the Google sign-in popup in your browser and try again.
googleErrors.cancelled-popup-request: Another sign-in window is open. Complete it before trying again.
googleErrors.unauthorized-domain: This site is not in Firebase Authorized domains. Check the configuration.
googleErrors.operation-not-allowed: Google sign-in is not enabled for this Firebase project.
googleErrors.admin-restricted-operation: Firebase rejected this account. Check the pre-created account and its Google identity link.
googleErrors.account-exists-with-different-credential: This email uses another sign-in method. Check the account linking first.
googleErrors.network-request-failed: Unable to reach Google or Firebase. Check your connection.
googleErrors.invalid-api-key: The Firebase public configuration is invalid. Check the API Key and project.
googleErrors.invalid-credential: The Google credential is invalid. Please sign in again.

backend.d1: Reload the page and try again
backend.d2: This account has not been granted access
backend.d6: Your session is invalid. Please sign in again
backend.d7: Please sign in with Google again

memoryLibrary.description: These are AI-organized candidates. Check their versions and original quotes; they are not independently verified facts.

memoryLibrary.filtered: No memories on this page have valid sources. You can continue loading.
memoryLibrary.failed: Unable to load memories. Check your sign-in and try again.
memoryLibrary.forbidden: Memories are currently available only to the owner test account.
memoryLibrary.detailFailed: Unable to load sources and versions. Click again to retry.
